newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Keramika to raise stakes in two firms.
newsitem.headline: Keramika to raise stakes in two firms.

text.p: Indonesian ceramics maker PT Keramika Indonesia Assosiasi said on Wednesday it planned to spend 125.5 billion rupiah to increase its stake in two ceramics firms.
Keramika said in a statement it planned to spend 97.35 billion rupiah to increase its stake to 100 percent from 21 percent in ceramics firm PT KIA Serpih Mas.
It said the firm also planned to spend 28.17 billion rupiah to raise its stake to 100 percent from 85 percent in subsidiary ceramics firm PT KIA Keramik Mas.

The share purchase was aimed partly at strengthening Keramika Indonesia's position as one of the country's largest ceramics producers, it said. The statement said the share purchase will wholly be financed by a rights issue.
Kia Keramik Mas posted a net profit of 13.3 billion rupiah in 1996 against 10.3 billion rupiah in 1995, the statement said.
Kia Serpih Mas posted a net profit of 11.1 billion rupiah in 1996 against 3.0 billion rupiah in 1995.
